description: A pad voice built by the PadSynth method: a spectrum is drawn, turned into a long wavetable by an inverse FFT, and read back at pitch

params.text: Sets how wide each partial is spread in the spectrum, 0.5 to 60; wider partials give the chorused, breathing quality of a pad
Sets how much that width grows towards the higher partials, 0.5 to 4
Sets the seed the partial strengths are drawn from, 0 to 1; every setting gives a different sound of the same character
Picks how the partial strengths are drawn: Harmonic Min, Even Min, Odd Min, Harmonic Weibull, Even Weibull, Odd Weibull, Voice or Static
Sets the level of the first partial on its own, 0 to 1

inputs.text: The pitch the wavetable is read at, 1V per octave, one channel per voice
A trigger here builds the wavetable again, which is how a change made from outside, such as by a mapping module, is taken up

outputs.text: The left side of the wave
The right side of the wave, which is the same table read half a cycle away, so the two sides differ

notes: every knob change builds the wavetable again in a background thread, which the patch carries on playing through; the new table is faded in over the time set in the menu
with the Static method the Seed knob is not a seed but a shape: at 0.5 every partial is present and the wave is saw-like, at 0 the odd partials alone give a pulse, and at 1 the even ones alone
menu: Fade Time — sets how long the module takes to cross from the old wavetable to a new one, which keeps a knob change from clicking

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
